predicate.statement: Inventory at least all five authority surfaces. ABG owns selection/advance; invocation/supervision; retry/correction/continuation/re-entry; runtime events/append/replay/projection; and closure/assurance, with product policy/gain inputs. Product/plugin roles are declarations and policy inputs, actor bindings/prompts/payload/evidence adapters, bounded outputs and control return, admitted evidence payload mapping, and domain interpretation/evaluators/gap reasons/weights. Forbidden local substitutes include next-step runners; spawn/spawnSync/exec/timeout/kill/stdout-stderr supervision outside the ABG seam; retries/controller memory/hidden next; direct event append/side-ledger mutation/bypassing reconstruction; self-report or postflight closure. Include language/tenant-appropriate code, call-graph or static-surface review and name evidence ruling out hidden execution authority; artifact review alone is insufficient.

value.definition: Total handling declares a next move for every admitted condition class, including an explicit unknown class. It does not assert recognition of every external condition, provider termination or completion of every request. A hanging call, unsatisfiable demand and lost post-effect response remain distinct cases.
value.label: Total handling and reconfiguration

grounding.quote:
### PC-04 — Recursive authority and information eligibility

A permitted A → B use does not entail A's access to B's dependencies. Neither
A → B plus B → C nor two routes to a shared leaf imply a union of their grants.
Each onward acquisition, disclosure or delegated effect needs authority for that
actor, purpose and path, including any permitted onward use of returned material.
Existing delegation may authorize a chain explicitly; its scope cannot expand
silently at a recursive step.

A provider may encapsulate internal dependencies behind an adequate contract.
Consumers need not flatten every implementation dependency into a direct edge.
Where an outer claim materially relies on a far-side contract, assumption,
evidence item or acquisition, that reliance and its applicable authority must be
preserved through the boundary. Unknown impact is not evidence of encapsulation.

Durable Product consumption and bounded authorized inspection are different
relations. A Reviewer or diagnostic Worker may inspect a larger causal cone under
an explicit access grant without thereby adopting those internals as a runtime
dependency or gaining a write grant. If findings become a continuing construction
constraint or dependency, their producer, applicability and governing relation
must be retained.

### PC-05 — Context construction and clean-room conditions

An actor's selected context must satisfy both permission and adequacy for its
engagement. Permission covers the source information and permitted derivations,
not only paths or filenames. The boundary identifies eligible source classes,
exports and tool outputs, material provenance, intended use, later acquisitions
and the effect of prior exposure. An allowed file location or a fresh summary
does not sanitize prohibited information.

A target owner may authorize an export, but clean-room eligibility additionally
requires that the engagement's information policy admits that export and its
provenance. The actual delivered/acquired material must be recorded to the extent
required by the claim. An uncertain or prohibited exposure follows the declared
hold/re-entry rule; it cannot be repaired by deleting its receipt or relabeling
the same actor fresh. Prior actor knowledge and external acquisition channels are
part of the declared limits.

Adequacy retains the distinctions required for the task's decisions and
continuations, including unresolved obligations, result standing, currentness and
authority. If the permitted material is insufficient, acquire an authorized
extension, narrow the task with the owner, use a suitable actor or return the
unresolved outcome. Permission is not evidence of sufficiency, and a budget is
not permission to omit a deciding condition. This applies [FOUNDATIONS Observation sufficiency](FOUNDATIONS.md#assurance-relations)
and its scoped preservation law; it supplies no general optimal context selector (P1, P2, P6).

qualifiers.meaning: The edge’s information contract must establish both permission and sufficient context for the recipient operation.

value.definition: U is the durable inventory of known material evaluations lacking an applicable closed result on the current basis; M is its selected finite dependency-ready part. The frontier is the readiness relation. The closed-result ledger records returned results, predicates, subject, basis, evidence and residuals. An applicable stop is an admitted work stop, including authority, capability or resource limits.
value.label: Attention cycle, frontier and ledger

predicate.statement: Three inseparable duties concern one governed outcome. Attention management retains exact outcome/basis, Product-role map, evaluation inventory, dependencies, unresolved frontier, actor envelopes, mandate, triage policy and residual boundary, selecting the smallest dependency-ready set sufficient for the next decision within finite envelopes. Orchestration activates capable Workers/Reviewers/specialists, preserves exact subject/basis and consumes only closed results or declared translations. Action selection assigns priority/boundary effect, applies existing disposition and issues only already-authorised next actions. Executive need not hold the whole workspace or perform every evaluation; its role grants no Product meaning, implementation, mutation, acceptance, publication or other operation authority. Material effects remain with actors holding exact operation grants.

exceptions: Where applicable law requires neither independent review nor reserved acceptance, recording without review follows the referenced existing-carrier route; sprint-close and applicable design-profile law still apply.
predicate.statement: Completion requires every applicable declared obligation satisfied by valid exact-subject/basis/scope evidence, every required judgment/ruling present and applicable, and no active non-closure condition. Unknown applicability or insufficient evidence for a mandatory obligation withholds dependent claim; the existing owner decides reserved acceptance. This is the referenced conjunction with obligations as required coverage, and SPEC_METHOD applies it over change spans. Review evaluates conditions but is not the closing event. Unchanged obligations reuse valid evidence/J/O. Material counterexamples, changed evidence, declared J revising observations and changed basis invalidate affected claim/dependent results before further reliance. Unrelated observations remain bounded repricing input and neither automatically reopen satisfied claims nor expand work. Closure recording preserves exact evaluated scope, satisfied conditions, evidence and residuals.
predicate.uncertainty: Full conjunction and recording-without-review protocols are external.
